# Provider response fixtures

Hand-authored from the documented nonstreaming response shapes of Ollama `/api/chat`,
`/api/embed` and OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions`, `/embeddings` (field names, nesting,
usage counters and error envelopes). Content is synthetic; vectors are shortened to small
dimensions. They were NOT captured from a live endpoint in this task: the sandbox denied the
local Ollama probe. Any future live capture must use synthetic prompts only.
